comment: Absolutely fantastic tour! Our guide, Kenji, was incredibly knowledgeable and passionate. We discovered hidden gems we would never have found on our own. The food stops were all delicious!
author: Sarah L., USA

comment: Highly recommend the Tsukiji tour! Fresh sushi in the morning was an unforgettable experience. Our guide expertly navigated the market and shared fascinating insights.
author: David P., Canada

comment: More than just a tour, it was a cultural immersion. Learned so much about Japanese customs and history while exploring the beautiful Imperial Palace East Garden. Our guide made it truly engaging.
author: Maria G., Spain

comment: Great value for money. Enjoyed trying various local foods. The meeting point was a bit confusing, but once the tour started, it was excellent.
